product: Origin (this repository today; a standalone product later). KPIs measure connecting an agent to the repo versus dumping files into a prompt.
not: Not a comparison to Anthropic Claude Design. Not billed token usage. Not Origin seat pricing.
when_user_asks_to_test: That re-measures context packs, graph:decide / what-uses queries, graph:test, evals, check-usage coverage, and a11y.
It writes metrics/snapshot.json (site + decisions) and metrics/last-run.json (timings and traces).
Read snapshot KPIs, say which are measured vs estimated, and recommend product work from the gaps — do not invent a better number.

baselines.dump_src: Paste every src/**/*.tsx file into the prompt.
baselines.dump_tracked: Paste every git-tracked file (when git is available).
baselines.connected_pack: manifest.json + llms.txt + AGENTS.md + brand/brand.json + tokens/*.json + rules/ux-rules.json + dls.config.json + skills/2one-dls/SKILL.md.
baselines.connected_query: Call graph:decide / what-uses and keep the JSON answer — do not dump the graph.
